x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

def compute_gcd(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

def compute_lcm(a, b):
    return a * b // compute_gcd(a, b)

def measure_difference(x1, y1, x2, y2):
    l = compute_lcm(y1, y2)
    diff = abs((l // y1) * x1 - (l // y2) * x2)
    return diff / l

min_diff = 1e15
min_b = 1
target_ratio = x / y

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    left, right = 1, 1000000
    while right - left > 1:
        mid = (left + right) // 2
        ratio = mid / i
        if ratio < target_ratio:
            left = mid
        else:
            right = mid
    candidate = left
    diff_left = measure_difference(candidate, i, x, y)
    diff_right = measure_difference(right, i, x, y)
    chosen = candidate if diff_left < diff_right else right
    current_diff = measure_difference(chosen, i, x, y)
    if current_diff < min_diff:
        min_diff = current_diff
        min_b = i

print(f"{min_b}/{n}")
